# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 25 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 25 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_025_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 5 — The Transition to the Shepherd

**1** The fifth vision came to me like this, my friends. **2** I was fasting, sitting alone on a mountain, giving thanks to God for everything he had done for me. Suddenly I was aware of a man sitting beside me — the Shepherd. He asked, "Why are you up here so early?" "Because, sir, I keep a station day here," I said. **3** He said simply: "I am the angel of repentance. I have been sent to stay with you for the rest of your life." **4** I suspected a test. "Who are you, exactly?" I said cautiously. "I know who has charge of me and who lives with me." He asked, "Don't you recognize me?" "No," I admitted. "I am the Shepherd," he said, "the one to whom you have been entrusted." **5** As he spoke, his appearance shifted — and I knew him. The one I had seen before. At once I was flooded with shame and confusion. Fear gripped me. I was crushed with grief over how rudely and stupidly I had spoken to him. **6** "Don't be confused," he said gently. "Be strengthened instead — I am here to give you commandments. I have been sent to show you again everything you have already seen, especially the things most critical for your life. Above all, keep my commandments and you will be pleasing to God. **7** Write the Commandments and the Parables." **8** With that he rose and was gone. I couldn't see where he went. A noise startled me and I spun around — the beast again, I thought. But there was nothing. Only the man, still sitting beside me.

---

*PNEUMA note: The Shepherd's identity is confirmed only when he changes form — his true nature hidden until the moment of recognition. This models the entire work: the truth of God's instruction comes dressed in unexpected forms.*
